summary.title: KNUTSEN SHUTTLE TANKERS 15 AS

narrative.text: KNUTSEN SHUTTLE TANKERS 15 AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Utenriks sjøfart med gods", registered 2011-06-07.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 229.8 million and an annual result of NOK 45.2 million.
Head office in Haugesund, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.

revenue_comparison.derivation: absolute_change = latest_revenue - previous_revenue; percent_change = absolute_change / previous_revenue * 100 (only when previous_revenue > 0)

summary.revenue_comparison_text: Revenue was NOK 229.8 million in 2025, up from NOK 169.5 million in 2024, an increase of NOK 60.3 million (35.5%).
